lines.text: Many learners say: How do you call this in English?
Better: What do you call this in English?
What! What do you call this fruit?

data.wrong: How do you call this in English?
data.right: What do you call this in English?

native.tip: «Как это называется?» — “What do you call this?”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “How do you call this in English”? 😅 По-русски «как», но с call нужно “what.” Правильно: “What do you call this in English?” Послушай Ама и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “What.” What do you call…? Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.caption: Do you also say “How do you call this in English”? 😅 With call, use “what.” Correct: “What do you call this in English?” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
